# `silk/text/word_dictionary_thai`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The ICU Thai word dictionary for `silk.text.word_dictionary`, as a packed minimal trie.

## When to use
Use `IcuDictionary` in `silk.text.word_dictionary`, which reads this data. Use this module only to
read the packed trie directly.

## Details
The data is `thaidict.txt` of ICU release 78.1: 26383 words in 17325 nodes. A node record is
seven bytes: the index of its first edge (big-endian u32), its edge count (u16) and 1 when a word
ends there (u8). An edge record is six bytes: a BMP scalar (u16) and the index of its child node
(u32). The edges of a node are sorted by scalar.

Import as `word_dictionary_thai` with `import silk.text.word_dictionary_thai as word_dictionary_thai`.

Public declarations: 3.
